remarks: Cedar Street Lofts. Modern 1000+/- SF, 2 Bedroom, 1.5 Bath Apartment with Soaring 12' High Ceilings In Historic Golden Hill. 2 Large Bedrooms w/Lots of Closet Space and Extra Storage. 1.5 High End Bathrooms. Chef's Kitchen with Deluxe Appliances: Stainless Steel Gas Stove, Refrigerator & Dishwasher. Granite Counter Tops & Lots of Cabinets. Washer & Dryer in Unit. Central Air. Hardwood Floors Throughout. Filled with Natural Light. 1 Off Street Parking Space Included. On Street Parking Available. Cedar Street Has Been Revitalized And Beautified! It's Filled With South Norwalk's Historic Charm! Easy access to Post Road & Shopping, I-95, Merritt Parkway and Route 7 Connector. SONO Is Just Down The Hill. Walk to SONO Collection Mall, Washington Street, Restaurants, The Maritime Aquarium & Metro North. 1 Month Security. Pets Welcome - case/by case.
